use.known: I've learnt a lot about this already.

use.target: 如果那个老女人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你姐姐。

use.known: I've learnt a lot since I started working here.

use.known: That young woman wants to learn from your mother.

use.known: I've already learnt a lot about how things work.
use.target: 我已经学了很多东西怎么做了。

use.known: That young man said he has finished the work.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人说他做完工作了。

use.known: If she has come, please let us know right away.

use.known: I've learnt a lot since I started reading books.
